```{r, eval = FALSE}
# First, in R download and install Bioconductor using
 
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(version = "3.19")
 
# Then install the GEOquery package:
 
BiocManager::install("GEOquery")
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Once installed, load this package
library(GEOquery)

drugdata <- getGEO("GSE57815")[[1]]
#methods(class=class(drugdata))
# Aside: The getGEO function will download a list – usually there is only one component in the list as in the case with your data which is why I used the [[1]] notation – you should check if multiple platforms were used and pull the correct item from the list.

 #help("ExpressionSet-class")
 
# The expression data can be extracted using the exprs() extractor function:
#expression=exprs(drugdata)  # this is G by N (number of genes by number of samples)

# The phenotypic data can be extracted using the pData() extractor function:
y = pData(drugdata)  # this is N by P (number of samples by number of phenotypic variables)

# select samples : Dose = 0 mg/kg, any duration
baseline2 <- drugdata[, pData(drugdata)$"dose:ch1" == "0 mg/kg"]
x = exprs(baseline2)


```


```{r}
#install.packages("matrixStats")
#install.packages("ggplot2")
library(matrixStats)
library(ggplot2)

xt = t(x) # transpose of data
sds = colSds(xt) # standard deviations of each rows and columns
#boxplot(sds)

# filtering variance > median variance across genes
xt_filter = xt[, sds > median(sds)]
#dim(xt_filter)

# Similarity measure: use absolute correlation between genes 
cormat = cor(xt_filter)
#dim(d)

# distance
d = 1 - abs(cormat)

# Hierarchical clustering
#hclust_complete = hclust(as.dist(d), method = "complete")

#plot(hclust_complete, labels = FALSE)

hclust_ward = hclust(as.dist(d), method = "ward.D2")

dendro_plot = plot(hclust_ward, labels = FALSE)

dendro_plot
```



```{r}
# Transpose the expression data
exprs_transposed <- t(exprs(drugdata))
pdata  = pData(drugdata)

# Combine the data#########
combined <- cbind(exprs_transposed, pData(drugdata))

tail(colnames(combined), 51)
```




```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1) Calculate expression means for controls (dose=0)
controls_mean = combined %>%
  filter(`dose:ch1` == "0 mg/kg") %>% 
  group_by(`vehicle:ch1`,
           `time:ch1`,
           `tissue:ch1`,
           `route:ch1`,
           `Sex:ch1`,
           `hybridization date:ch1`,
           `strain:ch1`) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

head(controls_mean)
```


```{r}
# 2) For each compound, calculate mean expression according to levels of a-g above. Don’t separate according to dose level
compound_mean = combined %>%
  group_by(`compound:ch1`, 
           `vehicle:ch1`,
           `time:ch1`,
           `tissue:ch1`,
           `route:ch1`,
           `Sex:ch1`,
           `hybridization date:ch1`,
           `strain:ch1`) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

head(compound_mean)
```

```{r}
compound_mean3 = combined %>%
```

```{r}
# 3) Calculate difference in mean expression for controls and exposed that match in terms of a-g above
mean_diff <- controls_mean %>%
  inner_join(compound_mean2, by = c("vehicle:ch1",
                                    "time:ch1",
                                    "tissue:ch1",
                                    "route:ch1",
                                    "Sex:ch1",
                                    "hybridization date:ch1",
                                    "strain:ch1"), suffix = c("_control", "_exposed")) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_control"), ~ . - get(sub("_control", "_exposed", cur_column())), .names = "diff_{col}"))

head(mean_diff)
```


```{r}
# 4) Calculate the mean difference in expression for each gene, averaged across compound.
# Doing the subtraction as matrix operations.

diff_cols <- mean_diff %>%
  select(starts_with("diff_"))

mean_diff_genes <- colMeans(as.matrix(diff_cols), na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# 5) Perform K means clustering of genes based on change in expression following exposure.
cluster_data <- t(as.data.frame(mean_diff_genes))

# Perform K-means clustering 
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
k <- 5 # Example
kmeans_result <- kmeans(clustering_data, centers = k)

# View cluster assignments
cluster_assignments <- data.frame(
  Gene = rownames(clustering_data),
  Cluster = kmeans_result$cluster
)

print(cluster_assignments)

```


```{r}
# 3) Calculate difference in mean expression for controls and exposed that match in terms of a-g above
# Separate data into controls and exposed
controls <- combined %>%
  filter(`dose:ch1` == "0 mg/kg")

exposed <- combined %>%
  filter(`dose:ch1` != "0 mg/kg")

# Calculate mean expression grouped by a-g for both controls and exposed
means_controls <- controls %>%
  group_by(`vehicle:ch1`,
           `time:ch1`,
           `tissue:ch1`,
           `route:ch1`,
           `Sex:ch1`,
           `hybridization date:ch1`,
           `strain:ch1`) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

means_exposed <- exposed %>%
  group_by(`vehicle:ch1`,
           `time:ch1`,
           `tissue:ch1`,
           `route:ch1`,
           `Sex:ch1`,
           `hybridization date:ch1`,
           `strain:ch1`) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the difference in mean expression for matched groups
mean_diff <- means_controls %>%
  inner_join(means_exposed, by = c("Vehicle", "Time", "Tissue", "Route", "Sex", "hybridization date", "Strain"), 
             suffix = c("_control", "_exposed")) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_control"), ~ . - get(sub("_control", "_exposed", cur_column())), .names = "diff_{col}"))
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "yellow", "red"))(100)

pheatmap(cormat, 
         color = my_palette,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         scale = "none",
         main = "Heatmap of Correlation Matrix (Subset)")
```

```{r}
#install.packages("gplots")

heatmap(cormat, Rowv = as.dendrogram(hclust_ward), Colv = as.dendrogram(hclust_ward), symm = TRUE)
```
